text: Here we stopped, and I obligingly reversed the car and restored to Mr Jopley his belongings. “A thousand thanks,” I said. “There’s more use in you than I thought. Now be off and find the police.” As I sat on the hillside, watching the tail-light dwindle, I reflected on the various kinds of crime I had now sampled. Contrary to general belief, I was not a murderer, but I had become an unholy liar, a shameless impostor, and a highwayman with a marked taste for expensive motor-cars.
